verdict.rationale: Godot exposes much of its editor functionality programmatically. EditorInterface covers saving and loading scenes and inspecting and editing resources, EditorScript `_run()` and editor plugins automate editor tasks in GDScript, and the official docs describe working entirely from the command line, including `--headless` runs for CI and exports. However, there is no documented guarantee that everything doable in the UI is reachable through an API. Automation mostly happens via in-process scripting or plugins rather than an external, agent-callable API: OpenAPI probes return 404, and there is no official MCP server, only fragmented community ones. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of UI/API parity, an external programmatic interface to the editor (REST/OpenAPI or official MCP), independent hands-on corroboration of full editor automation.
